answer: Each agent stakes a dune plot, locking 70 credits. Six neighbors on the horizon admit it, each staking 15 reputation, and none vouches for over two per epoch. Each epoch a lantern draw audits one in fifteen, which must answer a fresh lantern signal while the ring replays its log. A fake or rented ring burns the bond and slashes all six. Forging 1,000 identities costs 115,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its share.
